Team — forwarding Laura's note. Deal: Nova wants a 2yr $1.2M prepaid wallet with a 40% Q1 frontload and monthly drawdown + rolling 30-day reconciliations. They want a term discount tied to milestone tiers and an option for invoice acceleration tied to the frontload.

High-level options I think we can put on the table (want guidance on which to prioritize for the call):
1) Term-first (2yr): 8% off list on committed usage, wallet funded upfront, 40% frontload in Q1, monthly consumption reduces wallet. Monthly true-up with 30d reconciliation; unused credits after 24 months convert to overage at contracted renewed rate (or refund at 60% of unit price if under an agreed cap).
2) Milestone-tiered discount: 5% at 12mo, 7% at 18mo, 10% at 24mo — gives them runway while protecting us on early churn.
3) Acceleration incentive: if they pay full $1.2M upfront we give an additional 2% upfront discount + ability to invoice net-45 for the remainder of the first quarter (invoice acceleration).
4) Operational guardrails: replenishment triggers (auto top-up at 25% wallet remaining) or monthly replenishment windows, and a 6-month max carry-forward for unused credits.

Questions:
- Ben: can we approve up to 10% discount on the table with finance signoff?
- Marcus/Karthik: any billing/technical constraints for a 40% Q1 frontload and subsequent wallet depletion with monthly true-ups?
- Priya: what SOW language would we need to make the unused-credit fallback simple and audit-friendly?

I'll be on the customer call Tue 2026-08-10 09:00 PST. Please flag any hard no's before then.

— Soojin

Hi Laura / Tim — thanks for the productive conversation last week. Per the call and follow-up with pricing/ops, here's the tentative structure Redwood can put in a term sheet for legal: 

1) Deal economics:
- 24-month prepaid wallet: $1,200,000 funded upfront
- Effective term discount: 8% off list applied to committed units; additional conditional 2% incentive if full upfront funding is received and the 24mo SOW is executed (total up to 10% in that case)

2) Wallet & drawdown cadence:
- Q1 frontload: 40% of wallet available immediately to accommodate launch spike
- Monthly consumption reduces the wallet; monthly statements provided with a 30-day reconciliation window
- Auto-top-up: optional; customer must opt-in. If enabled, top-ups execute when wallet <=25% and are configurable (manual or automated)

3) Unused-credit handling:
- Carry-forward allowed up to 6 months beyond the 24mo term for credits below a defined cap (10% of initial wallet)
- Credits above the cap at contract end convert to overage at the agreed list rate or are refundable at 60% of unit price if both parties agree in writing (rare)

4) Invoice/payment terms:
- Standard: full wallet payment at execution (Net-30).
- Acceleration option: if Nova funds the full $1.2M immediately, Redwood will extend an extra 2% discount and allow net-45 for any implementation milestone invoices agreed in the SOW.

5) Operational / SOW items:
- SOW appendix will specify reporting cadence, true-up statement format, API/webhook for top-up triggers, and audit logs exported monthly
- Legal to include a short schedule that defines 'unused credits' calculation and the cap/carry-forward mechanics

Next steps:

- HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4391 (I've attached the price strip and the term sheet draft in Drive).
